scope: post-primary retrospective exploratory national country-scenario hierarchy

models.B1: calendar all coordinates; structural context national mean only
models.B2: calendar and structural context all coordinates

case_weights_for_preprocessing_only: one total per eligible donor country
likelihood_weights: one per donor round; country random intercept covariance models repeated countries
unknown_country_handling: analytically integrate unseen country random intercept; do not estimate from held-out records
point_estimate: analytic posterior predictive mean, bounded to [0,100] for primary loss; raw saved
inference: exact normal-inverse-gamma updates and finite prior-mixture integration, no MCMC or ADVI
predictive_interval_accuracy_check: compare independent first-half and second-half 2.5/97.5% quantiles of all five scenarios, mean, four contrast coordinates; if maximum endpoint difference >2pp, repeat using 100000 seeded draws; retain any residual failure as disclosed imprecision, not model selection
